rules.description: Exact paid draw when this card's damage is canceled.
rules.pattern: ^(?:\[[^\]]+\]\s*)?when damage dealt by this card is canceled, you may pay the cost\. if you do, draw (?P<draw_count>\d+) card(?:s)?\.?$

rules.description: Exact self-turn paid burn on battle-opponent reverse.
rules.pattern: ^(?:\[[^\]]+\]\s*)?during your turn, when this card's battle opponent becomes 【reverse】, you may pay the cost\. if you do, deal (?P<damage>\d+) damage to your opponent\.\s*\(damage may be canceled\)\.?$

rules.description: Exact on-play or by-ACT top-clock heal.
rules.pattern: ^when this card is placed on the stage from your hand or by the 【act】 effect of "[^"]+", you may put the top card of your clock into your waiting room\.?$

rules.description: Exact paid salvage for on-play or on-leave dual trigger lines.
rules.pattern: ^(?:\[[^\]]+\]\s*)?when this card is placed on the stage from your hand or put into your waiting room from the stage, you may pay the cost\. if you do, choose (?:up to )?(?:\d+|one|a|an) character in your waiting room, and return (?:it|them) to your hand\.?$

rules.description: Exact attack trigger salvage with a named-climax gate.
rules.pattern: ^when this card attacks, if a card named "[^"]+" is in your climax area, you may choose(?: up to)?(?: (?:\d+|one|a|an))? character in your waiting room, and return (?:it|them) to your hand\.?$

rules.description: Exact fallback for broad all-player following grants with a known quote payload.
rules.pattern: ^all of (?:your|your opponent's) characters get the following ability(?: until end of turn)?\.\s*"【CONT】 This card cannot side attack\."\.?$

rules.description: Exact battle-opponent reverse self move-to-memory conversion.
rules.pattern: ^when this card's battle opponent becomes 【reverse】, you may put this card into your memory(?:\. if you do, .+)?$

rules.description: Exact climax-placed team buff/following conversion.
rules.pattern: ^when (?:your|a) climax is placed on your climax area, choose (?:up to )?(?P<count>(?:\d+|a|an|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten)) of your characters, and (?:that character gets \+(?P<power>\d+) power(?: and \+(?P<soul>\d+) soul)? until end of turn|that character gets the following ability until end of turn\.\s*"(?P<quoted>.+)")\.?$

rules.description: Exact frontal-attacked top-card look decision.
rules.pattern: ^when this card is frontal attacked, look at the top card of your deck, and put it on the top of your deck or into your waiting room\.?$

rules.description: Exact on-play self power plus quoted following ability.
rules.pattern: ^when this card is placed on (?:the )?stage from your hand, this card gets \+(?P<amount>\d+) power and the following ability until the end of your opponent's next turn\.\s*"(?P<quoted>.+)"\.?$

rules.description: Exact self OnReverse move-to-deck-bottom conversion.
rules.pattern: ^when this card becomes 【reverse】(?: in battle)?, put this card at the bottom of your deck\.?$

rules.description: Exact self OnReverse move-to-memory conversion.
rules.pattern: ^when this card becomes 【reverse】(?: in battle)?(?:,\s*)?(?:you may )?put this card into your memory\.?$

rules.description: Exact paid on-play salvage with optional trailing team power clause.
rules.pattern: ^(?:\[[^\]]+\]\s*)?when this card is placed on (?:the )?stage from your hand, you may pay the cost\. if you do, choose (?:up to )?(?P<count>(?:\d+|a|an|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten)) (?P<selector>.+?) in your waiting room, return (?:it|them) to your hand(?:, choose .+?, and that character gets \+\d+ power until end of turn)?\.?$

rules.description: Exact paid on-play deck search to hand.
rules.pattern: ^(?:\[[^\]]+\]\s*)?when this card is placed on (?:the )?stage from your hand, you may pay the cost\. if you do, search your deck for up to (?P<count>(?:\d+|a|an|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten)) (?P<selector>.+?), reveal (?:it|them) to your opponent, put (?:it|them) into your hand, and shuffle your deck(?: afterwards)?\.?$

rules.description: Exact terminal outcome conditional statements.
rules.pattern: ^if [^,]+, you (?P<result>win|lose) the game\.?$

rules.description: Exact terminal outcome direct statements.
rules.pattern: ^you (?P<result>win|lose) the game\.?$

rules.description: Exact experience level-total power, including quoted follow-up payloads.
rules.pattern: ^experience(?P<self_turn>\s+during your turn)?, if the total level of (?:the )?cards in your level is (?P<level_total>(?:\d+|a|an|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten)) or higher, this card gets \+(?P<power>\d+) power(?: and the following ability\.\s*"(?P<quoted>.+)")?\.?$

rules.description: Exact facing-opponent quoted restriction conversion.
rules.pattern: ^the character facing this card gets\s*"(?P<quoted>.+)"\.?$

rules.description: Exact marker-gated continuous self power.
rules.pattern: ^if there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets \+(?P<power>\d+) power\.?$

rules.description: Exact marker-gated power with quoted following ability payload.
rules.pattern: ^if there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets \+(?P<power>\d+) power and the following ability\.\s*"(?P<quoted>.+)"\.?$

rules.description: Exact marker-gated continuous self power and soul.
rules.pattern: ^if there is a marker underneath this card, this card gets \+(?P<power>\d+) power and \+(?P<soul>\d+) soul\.?$

rules.description: Approx fallback for Change to a named waiting-room target at encore step.
rules.pattern: ^change\s+\[[^\]]+\]\s+at the beginning of your encore step,(?:\s*if this card is 【rest】,\s*)?you may pay the cost\. if you do, choose (?:up to )?(?:1|one)\s*(?:a card named\s*)?"[^"]+" in your waiting room, and put it on the stage position that this card was on\.?$

rules.description: Approx fallback for name-fragment power + quoted extra text.
rules.pattern: ^if you have another character with "[^"]+" in its card name, this card gets \+(?P<amount>\d+) power and "[^"]+"\.?$

rules.description: Approx fallback for low-board conditional mill then stage deploy.
rules.pattern: ^when this card attacks, if you have \d+ or less other characters, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room\. if that card is a level \d+ or lower character, put that character on any position of your back stage\.?$

rules.description: Approx fallback for no-backstage conditional mill then stage deploy.
rules.pattern: ^when this card attacks, if you do not have another character in your back stage, you may put the top card of your deck into your waiting room\. if that card is a level \d+ or lower character, put that character in any position of your back stage\.?$

rules.description: Approx fallback for reveal-top trait gate with optional burn.
rules.pattern: ^when this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck\. if that card is a 《[^》]+》 character, you may deal one damage to your opponent\. \(this damage may be canceled\. the revealed card is returned to its original place\)\.?$

rules.description: Approx fallback for reveal-top event/trait marker conversion.
rules.pattern: ^when this card is placed on the stage from your hand, reveal the top card of your deck\. if that card is an event or a 《[^》]+》 character, you may put it face up underneath this card as a marker\. \(otherwise, return it to its original place\)\.?$

rules.description: Approx fallback for all-player following-ability grants with quoted payloads.
rules.pattern: ^all of (?:your|your opponent's) characters get the following ability(?: until (?:the end of your opponent's next turn|end of turn))?\.\s*"[^"]+"\.?$

rules.description: Approx fallback for choose-character following-ability grants.
rules.pattern: ^choose (?:up to )?(?:\d+|a|an|one|two|three|four|five|six|seven|eight|nine|ten) of (?:your|your opponent's) characters(?: in battle)?, and that character gets the following ability(?: until (?:the end of your opponent's next turn|end of turn))?\.\s*"[^"]+"\.?$

rules.description: Approx fallback for "When you use this card's ..." lines with quoted or following-ability payloads.
rules.pattern: ^when you use this card's .*(?:following ability|"[^"]+").*$

rules.description: Approx fallback for brainstorm lines with custom quoted actions.
rules.pattern: ^brainstorm\s+(?:flip over|reveal)\s+(?P<reveal_count>\d+)\s+cards?\s+from the top of your deck, and put them into your waiting room\.\s+for each climax revealed(?: among those cards)?,\s*perform the following action\.\s*"[^"]+"\.?$

rules.description: Approx fallback for broad all-players quoted action templates.
rules.pattern: ^all players perform the following action\.\s*"[^"]+"\.?$

rules.description: Approx fallback for broad quoted-grant lines that did not match higher-priority rules.
rules.pattern: ^(?:this card|all of your characters|all of your opponent's characters|the character facing this card|choose .+?) get(?:s)?(?: the following ability)?(?: until [^.]+)?(?:\.\s*|\s+)"[^"]+"\.?$

rules.description: Last-resort approx fallback for any remaining quoted following-ability text.
rules.pattern: ^.*following ability.*"[^"]+".*$

rules.description: Strict fallback for following-ability lines that keep a quoted payload.
rules.pattern: ^.*following ability.*".*".*$

rules.description: Strict fallback for broad paid on-play search/salvage text families.
rules.pattern: ^.*placed on (?:the )?stage from your hand.*pay the cost.*(?:look at|search|return .* to your hand).*$

rules.description: Strict fallback for climax-placed buff family lines.
rules.pattern: ^when (?:your|a) climax is placed on your climax area.*$

rules.description: Strict fallback for experience family lines.
rules.pattern: ^experience .+$

rules.description: Strict fallback for OnReverse self-move family lines.
rules.pattern: ^.*becomes 【reverse】.*(?:put this card at the bottom of your deck|put this card into your memory).*$

rules.description: Strict fallback for assist/scaling power family lines with explicit numeric power.
rules.pattern: ^.*gets \+(?P<amount>\d+) power.*$

rules.description: Strict fallback for scaling-power X-valued templates.
rules.pattern: ^.*gets \+x power.*$

rules.description: Strict fallback for remaining quoted lines after family-specific strict rules.
Catch-all approx fallback for any remaining unmatched tagged line.
